characters.descriptor: A 68-year-old British man with a slight, lean build, an angular weathered jawline, pale blue eyes, and thin, receding silver hair neatly combed back, with faint age spots along his temples.

wardrobe.grooming: neatly combed silver hair, clean-shaven, reserved and still posture

wardrobe.outfit: a heavy dark wool overcoat buttoned over a worn charcoal-grey buttoned wool cardigan, a faded beige collared cotton shirt, and dark pressed wool trousers
wardrobe.grooming: silver hair slightly shifted by outdoor cold, clean-shaven, rigid and upright posture

locations.name: Walter's Front Room
locations.descriptor: A narrow, dim Victorian parlour in a Leeds terrace house, dominated by an upright dark mahogany piano with yellowed ivory keys and a framed black-and-white portrait resting on top. Pale lace curtains filter muted twilight against faded patterned wallpaper, dark polished floorboards, and a worn armchair.

locations.name: Terrace Kitchen
locations.descriptor: A compact, utilitarian terraced galley kitchen with pale tiled walls, a stainless steel draining rack holding a single teacup, and an untouched second mug resting alone on an upper shelf. Cool daylight enters through a frosted sash window above muted laminate countertops.

locations.name: Entrance Hallway
locations.descriptor: A narrow, high-ceilinged Victorian entrance hall with draughty wooden floorboards, faded wallpaper, a wall-mounted corded telephone, and an empty dark timber coat rack near the front door.

locations.name: Cemetery Bench
locations.descriptor: A desolate municipal graveyard under a dark winter sky, featuring weathered stone headstones dusted with frost, silhouettes of barren trees, and a solitary wooden bench beside a snow-dusted grave.

thumbnail_shot.description: Vast negative space and deep shadow fill the left half of the frame; on the right, Walter sits in sharp profile beside the dark upright piano, his face and round wire-rimmed glasses bathed in the eerie amber glow of his phone resting on the music desk, surrounded by imposing, silent darkness.
